errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the lowest value occurred in 2020 with a value of about 40,000. The figure shows the lowest value is in 2019 (approx. 44,000), while the value for 2020 is significantly higher (approx. 61,000).
There is a typo in the legend item name "Акции и дялове на КИС/ Борсово търгувани продукти". "кис" should be capitalized as "КИС".
